id: 09_Properties of Ionizing Radiation Alpha Beta Gamma
title: 电离辐射的性质：α、β、γ
source_doc: course/RSO Training Series/09_Properties of Ionizing Radiation Alpha Beta Gamma.md
author_source: project/RSO Training Series/09_Properties of Ionizing Radiation Alpha Beta Gamma/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验桌旁，桌上有探测器和三块屏蔽片，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a detector and three shielding plates, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来比一比三种射线。

shots.scene: α、β、γ三个符号卡片排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards in a row with simple particle and wave icons. No people.
shots.narration: 看它们电离能力和穿透能力有啥不同。

shots.scene: 阿杰在物理实验课上举手，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand in a physics lab class, a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：射线不都一样吗？

shots.scene: 小研穿着便装，把探测器和屏蔽片摆好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in casual clothes sets up a detector and shielding plates on a bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：做个实验就知道了。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向桌上的计数器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a counter box with a blank display on the bench.
shots.narration: 我们先认识这台探测器。

shots.scene: 两个图标：原子周围的电离火花、穿墙的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: sparks of ionization around an atom, and an arrow passing through a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 比两样：电离本领和穿透本领。

shots.scene: 纸、铝片、铅片三块屏蔽依次排开
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper, an aluminum plate and a lead plate lined up on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 工具很简单：纸、铝片、铅片。

shots.scene: 支架上的金属管探测器，管口特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a tube-shaped radiation detector on a stand, showing its open window end. No people.
shots.narration: 这是盖革管，射线从管口进入。

shots.scene: 管子用电线连到计数器盒子
shots.prompt_en: The detector tube is connected by a cable to a counter box with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 它连着计数器。

shots.scene: 计数器上一个光点进入，显示屏数字加一
shots.prompt_en: A glowing dot enters the tube and the counter display ticks up by one. No people.
shots.narration: 每测到一个射线粒子，读数就加一。

shots.scene: 桌上没有任何源，计数器数字仍在慢慢上涨
shots.prompt_en: The bench has no source on it, but the counter display still slowly ticks up. No people.
shots.narration: 怪了，还没放源，读数就在涨。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着计数器，周围漂浮着小光点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the counter while tiny glowing dots float in the air around it.
shots.narration: 这是本底辐射，一直在我们身边。

shots.scene: 天空射下的光线和岩石土壤图标
shots.prompt_en: Rays coming down from the sky above a rocky hill and soil. No people.
shots.narration: 宇宙射线，岩石和土壤。

shots.scene: 地下冒出淡淡气体飘进房间
shots.prompt_en: Faint gas rising from the ground into a room. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里的氡，也在放出射线。

shots.scene: 核设施图标和密封废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nuclear power plant and sealed waste drums. No people.
shots.narration: 核设施和放射性废物，也有一份贡献。

shots.scene: 医院扫描设备图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hospital imaging scanner. No people.
shots.narration: 医学应用，也是来源之一。

shots.scene: 饼图：氡、岩土、宇宙、食物、医疗
shots.prompt_en: A blank pie chart with five colored slices and small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 各种来源加起来，就是本底。

shots.scene: 射线打在DNA双螺旋上，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A ray hits a DNA double helix with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电离辐射会损伤DNA。

shots.scene: 细胞图标变色并异常分裂
shots.prompt_en: A cell icon changing color and dividing abnormally. No people.
shots.narration: 严重时，可能导致癌症。

shots.scene: 小研空手握着镊子，夹起小圆柱源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in casual clothes, with bare hands, picks up a small cylinder source with tweezers.
shots.narration: 所以整个实验，都用镊子夹源。

shots.scene: 徒手拿源的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand holding a radioactive source, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用手直接拿，尽量少受照。

shots.scene: 原子核射出一个由两红两蓝小球组成的粒子
shots.prompt_en: A nucleus shoots out a particle made of two red balls and two blue balls. No people.
shots.narration: 先看α粒子。

shots.scene: 两个质子带正号，两个中子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the particle: two protons with plus signs and two neutrons. No people.
shots.narration: 它由两个质子和两个中子组成，带正电。

shots.scene: 夹具把α源推近探测器，计数器数字飞快跳动
shots.prompt_en: A clamp moves an alpha source close to the detector tube and the counter numbers jump rapidly. No people.
shots.narration: α源一靠近，计数猛增。

shots.scene: 源沿尺子往后拉，计数几乎停下
shots.prompt_en: The source is pulled back along a ruler and the counter almost stops. No people.
shots.narration: 拉开两三厘米，几乎测不到了。

shots.scene: α粒子周围一大片电离火花，但很快停住
shots.prompt_en: An alpha particle makes many ionization sparks around it but stops after a very short path. No people.
shots.narration: α电离本领很强，但走不远。

shots.scene: 镊子把一张纸插到源和探测器之间
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers slide a sheet of paper between the source and the detector tube. No people.
shots.narration: 再把源推近，中间插一张纸。

shots.scene: 计数器数字变慢
shots.prompt_en: The counter numbers slow down sharply. No people.
shots.narration: 计数一下子慢了下来。

shots.scene: 纸被抽走，计数器又飞快跳动
shots.prompt_en: The paper is pulled away and the counter numbers jump fast again. No people.
shots.narration: 抽走纸，又猛涨——纸挡住了α。

shots.scene: 原子核射出一个带负号的小电子
shots.prompt_en: A nucleus shoots out a tiny electron with a minus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 再看β粒子。

shots.scene: 高速电子拖着长尾巴飞出
shots.prompt_en: A fast electron flies away with a long trail. No people.
shots.narration: 它是原子核放出的高能电子。

shots.scene: β源靠近探测器，计数器快速跳动
shots.prompt_en: A clamp moves a beta source close to the detector tube and the counter jumps quickly. No people.
shots.narration: β源靠近，计数也很快。

shots.scene: 源沿尺子拉到十几厘米远，计数仍在涨
shots.prompt_en: The source is pulled far back along the ruler, and the counter still keeps rising. No people.
shots.narration: 拉开十几厘米，还能测到不少。

shots.scene: α短箭头和β长箭头对比
shots.prompt_en: A short arrow labeled with an alpha icon next to a much longer arrow with a beta icon. No people.
shots.narration: β比α走得远得多。

shots.scene: 镊子把纸插到β源前，计数不变
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers slide paper in front of the beta source and the counter keeps rising. No people.
shots.narration: 一张纸，挡不住β。

shots.scene: 薄铝片插入，计数仍在涨
shots.prompt_en: A thin aluminum sheet is placed in front of the source and the counter still rises. No people.
shots.narration: 薄铝片，也挡不住多少。

shots.scene: 厚铝板插入，计数几乎停住
shots.prompt_en: A thicker aluminum plate is placed in front of the source and the counter nearly stops. No people.
shots.narration: 换成厚一些的铝板，才把β挡住。

shots.scene: 原子核发出一束波浪线
shots.prompt_en: A nucleus emits a beam of wavy lines. No people.
shots.narration: 最后是γ射线。

shots.scene: 电磁波谱长条，最右端高亮
shots.prompt_en: A long electromagnetic spectrum band with the shortest-wave end highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 它不是粒子，是高能光子，属于电磁波。

shots.scene: 一个贴空白标签的棕色小瓶直接放在桌面上，被推到探测器前
shots.prompt_en: A small brown bottle with a blank label, standing directly on the bare bench top, is pushed in front of the detector tube. No people.
shots.narration: 这次用含钍的化合物作射线源。

shots.scene: 计数器飞快跳动
shots.prompt_en: The counter numbers jump fast. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近时，计数很多。

shots.scene: 瓶子拉远，计数变慢但不停
shots.prompt_en: The bottle is moved farther away; the counter slows down but never stops. No people.
shots.narration: 拉远了会下降，但降不到零。

shots.scene: 纸、薄铝、厚铝依次插入，计数照样涨
shots.prompt_en: Paper, a thin aluminum sheet and a thick aluminum plate are placed in turn; the counter keeps rising. No people.
shots.narration: 纸和铝，对γ几乎没作用。

shots.scene: 镊子放入一块厚铅片，计数略慢
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers place a thick lead disc in front of the source; the counter slows only a little. No people.
shots.narration: 厚铅片，也只是减弱一点。

shots.scene: 再加一块铅片，计数再慢一些，仍不停
shots.prompt_en: A second lead disc is added; the counter slows a bit more but still does not stop. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一块铅，还是挡不完。

shots.scene: 三支箭头穿过三层屏蔽，只有波浪线穿过铅
shots.prompt_en: Three arrows hit paper, aluminum and lead; only the wavy line passes partly through the lead. No people.
shots.narration: γ穿透力最强，只能用厚铅等减弱。

shots.scene: 跷跷板一端是电离火花，一端是穿墙箭头
shots.prompt_en: A seesaw with ionization sparks on one end and an arrow through a wall on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 电离本领和穿透本领，此消彼长。

shots.scene: α在电离端高高翘起，γ在穿透端
shots.prompt_en: An alpha icon sits high on the ionization side and a gamma icon on the penetration side. No people.
shots.narration: α电离最强、穿透最弱，γ正好相反。

shots.scene: 总结图：α、β、γ分别被纸、铝、铅挡住
shots.prompt_en: A summary chart: alpha stopped by paper, beta stopped by aluminum, gamma reduced by lead. No people.
shots.narration: 纸挡α，铝挡β，铅减弱γ。

shots.scene: 空气中三条长短不同的射程线
shots.prompt_en: Three lines of different lengths showing ranges in air for three kinds of radiation. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里，α最短，β居中，γ最远。

shots.scene: 电场两块极板之间，三束射线一束向上、一束向下、一束直行
shots.prompt_en: Between two charged plates, one beam bends up, one bends down and one goes straight. No people.
shots.narration: 在电场和磁场里，α、β偏向相反，γ不偏。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现计数器和本底图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a counter and background sources.
shots.narration: 没放源也在计数，那是本底。

shots.scene: α、β、γ三个图标和纸、铝、铅
shots.prompt_en: Icons of alpha, beta and gamma next to paper, aluminum and lead. No people.
shots.narration: α纸挡，β铝挡，γ要厚铅减弱。

shots.scene: 跷跷板图标
shots.prompt_en: A seesaw icon with sparks on one side and an arrow through a wall on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 电离强的走不远，穿透强的电离弱。

shots.scene: 镊子夹着小圆柱源的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of tweezers holding a small cylinder source. No people.
shots.narration: 射线伤DNA，全程用镊子夹源。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验桌旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye beside a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 三种射线，各有脾气，下次见！
